name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 lakh for non-farm micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, services and activities allied to agriculture, across four size categories.
administering_ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
implementing_agency: Banks, NBFCs and micro finance institutions, refinanced by MUDRA Ltd
benefit_description: Collateral-free loans in four categories: Shishu up to Rs 50,000; Kishor Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh; Tarun Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh; Tarun Plus Rs 10 lakh to Rs 20 lakh.

criteria.description: The enterprise must be a micro unit. Turnover well within the micro threshold is expected, since the facility is capped at Rs 20 lakh.
The activity must be non-farm income generating in manufacturing, trading, services or allied to agriculture. Direct crop agriculture is excluded.
The borrower should not be a defaulter with any bank or financial institution and should have a satisfactory credit record.

document_requirements.issuing_authority_name: Aadhaar, voter ID, passport or driving licence
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Existing documents are accepted; no new issuance needed in most cases.

document_requirements.document_name: Business existence proof or quotation for machinery to be purchased
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Registration documents for an existing unit, or supplier quotations where the loan funds an asset purchase.

document_requirements.document_name: Bank statements for the preceding 6 months
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Download from net banking or request at your branch.

windows.notes: No window. Apply at any participating bank branch, or through the Jan Samarth portal, at any time.

benefits.description: Collateral-free term loan or working capital facility, in the Shishu, Kishor, Tarun or Tarun Plus category by amount.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Credit, not a grant. Interest and repayment apply, at rates set by the lending institution.
benefits.source_quote: four categories namely Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 20 lakh).
